scripts.generate:all: pnpm run build && node dist/index.js all
scripts.generate:smart: pnpm run build && node dist/index.js all -- --skip-passing
scripts.generate:force: pnpm run build && node dist/index.js all -- --force
scripts.generate:adjacent: pnpm run build && node dist/index.js all -- --adjacent
scripts.generate:smart-adjacent: pnpm run build && node dist/index.js all -- --skip-passing --adjacent
scripts.test:cache: pnpm run build && node dist/index.js cache-stats
scripts.test:clear-cache: pnpm run build && node dist/index.js clear-cache
scripts.fix: pnpm run build && node dist/index.js fix
scripts.fix:all: pnpm run generate:smart && pnpm run fix
scripts.fix:force: pnpm run generate:force && pnpm run fix -- --force
scripts.list-models: pnpm run build && node dist/index.js list-models
